tokens.name: surface.page
tokens.usage: Screen background.

tokens.name: surface.raised
tokens.usage: Anything that sits on the page: inputs, cards, the account card, menus.

tokens.name: text.primary
tokens.usage: Headings, body text and meaningful icons. 17.3:1 light, 16.9:1 dark on surface.page.

tokens.name: text.secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text, hints, quiet buttons. 6.2:1 light, 7.5:1 dark on surface.page.

tokens.name: text.on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action.primary.

tokens.name: action.primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and selected controls (checkbox, radio, switch on). One primary button per screen.

tokens.name: border.subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative, so no contrast requirement.

tokens.name: border.control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and unselected controls, the off switch track and the unfilled slider track. 3.1:1 light, 3.3:1 dark on surface.raised; 2.85:1 light, 3.5:1 dark on surface.page (below 3:1 in light, open).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Text links and the focus ring. 6.6:1 light, 8.3:1 dark on surface.page.

tokens.name: danger.text
tokens.usage: Validation messages, error icons, the border of an invalid input. 5.8:1 light, 8.3:1 dark on surface.page.

tokens.name: danger.surface
tokens.usage: Error banner fill and the halo around an invalid input.

tokens.name: danger.border
tokens.usage: Error banner border.

tokens.name: success.text
tokens.usage: Success mark and confirmation icons. 4.8:1 light, 8.4:1 dark on success.surface.

tokens.name: success.surface
tokens.usage: Background of the success mark.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per screen: the screen title.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section titles inside a screen, such as groups in a settings form.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text and intros, links inside them included.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis in body text and names, such as the account name.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Validation messages and secondary lines, such as the account email.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Overlines and group labels, in capitals. Never for sentences.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Text on every button, quiet ones included.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Text typed into fields and the selected value of a select.

tokens.name: space.1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside a component: title to description in banners and cards, label to description in rows.

tokens.name: space.2
tokens.usage: Label to field, field to message, an icon to its text in messages, buttons and selects.

tokens.name: space.3
tokens.usage: Title to intro, gaps inside banners and cards.

tokens.name: space.4
tokens.usage: Padding inside fields, banners and cards.

tokens.name: space.5
tokens.usage: Between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space.6
tokens.usage: Screen side margins.

tokens.name: space.8
tokens.usage: Intro to form, between form sections.

tokens.name: space.10
tokens.usage: Large gaps between screen regions.

tokens.name: space.12
tokens.usage: Space above a bottom action area.

tokens.name: space.14
tokens.usage: Header to title on entry screens.

tokens.name: radius.sm
tokens.usage: Checkbox and other small marks.

tokens.name: radius.md
tokens.usage: Fields, buttons, icon buttons, banners, cards, menus.

tokens.name: radius.full
tokens.usage: Avatars, the success mark, switch tracks, radio dots, slider tracks and thumbs.

tokens.name: size.control
tokens.usage: Height of text fields, selects and every button, quiet ones included.

tokens.name: size.target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for anything tappable, text links included.

tokens.name: size.icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside text-sized elements: validation messages, the checkbox tick.

tokens.name: size.icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in controls and banners: password toggle, select chevron, alert icon, spinner.

tokens.name: size.mark
tokens.usage: Checkbox box, radio circle, switch thumb and slider thumb.

tokens.name: size.dot
tokens.usage: The dot inside a selected radio.

tokens.name: size.avatar
tokens.usage: Avatar in the account card.

tokens.name: size.switch-width
tokens.usage: Switch track width: two thumbs plus space.1 on each side.

tokens.name: size.switch-height
tokens.usage: Switch track height: one thumb plus space.1 above and below.

tokens.name: size.slider-track
tokens.usage: Height of the slider track. The thumb is size.mark.

tokens.name: size.icon-lg
tokens.usage: The icon inside a status mark.

tokens.name: size.status-mark
tokens.usage: Status mark on confirmation screens, such as signed in.

tokens.name: stroke.default
tokens.usage: Borders of fields, cards and banners.

tokens.name: stroke.focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, drawn in accent with a 2px gap of surface.page.

tokens.name: shadow.overlay
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers that float above content (select options). Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow.focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every interactive element: a stroke.focus gap of surface.page, then a stroke.focus ring of accent.

tokens.name: shadow.danger-halo
tokens.usage: Halo around an invalid field, together with a danger.text border.

tokens.name: opacity.disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and fields locked while a request runs. The only opacity in the system.

tokens.name: duration.spin
tokens.usage: One full turn of the loading spinner. Atlas has no other motion yet.

tokens.name: layer.overlay
tokens.usage: Stacking order of menus and popovers above page content. Code only: Figma has no stacking order.
